notes: All five reviewers and the EIC ran in one model context (disclosed). Figures 2-5 were unavailable, so all curve-based evidence was judged from captions and text; no weakness depends on a figure value. The skill's search script returned many off-topic knowledge-distillation hits for 'distillation' queries and prints long abstracts (no compact output mode). The shell sandbox in this run rejected compound commands, so tool calls had to be split. Eq. 10/11 numeric check depends on a CIFAR-10 size (50,000) not printed in the paper; marked derived. The skill gives no explicit rule for how the EIC's own pool position feeds the scripts (it is only reported in summary). Pool-position band for Overall 2 vs 3 is implicit (<42 vs 42-54); R3's pool 35 mapped to band 42-54 per the script while the pool position <42 would imply Overall 2, a small ambiguity between pool-position bands and the scores the rubric asks for.
